cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(BPRCenterSpeedometer LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(IMGUI_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/bpr-mods/vendor/imgui/modules/imgui")
add_library(imgui STATIC ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui.cpp ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp ${IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp ${IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx11.cpp)
target_include_directories(imgui PUBLIC ${IMGUI_DIR} ${IMGUI_DIR}/backends)
target_link_libraries(imgui PUBLIC d3d11 dxgi d3dcompiler)
add_subdirectory(third_party/minhook EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(CenterSpeedometer SHARED src/Plugin.cpp src/Proxy.def)
target_compile_definitions(CenterSpeedometer PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_link_libraries(CenterSpeedometer PRIVATE imgui minhook)
set_target_properties(CenterSpeedometer PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME dinput8)
add_executable(SpeedometerPreview WIN32 src/Preview.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(SpeedometerPreview PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_link_libraries(SpeedometerPreview PRIVATE imgui)
